# Better Tennessee

> > Better Tennessee connects communities across East Tennessee with vital health and social services through strategic partnerships.

Better Tennessee serves as a network hub highlighting organizations providing mental health, addiction treatment, maternal-fetal medicine, and community services across Tennessee counties including Anderson, Blount, Bradley, Campbell, Claiborne, Cocke, Grainger, Greene, Hamblen, Hamilton, Hawkins, and Jefferson. The platform focuses on improving access to healthcare and social support throughout East Tennessee.

## Key Topics

- East Tennessee
- Tennessee Counties (Anderson, Blount, Bradley, Campbell, Claiborne, Cocke, Grainger, Greene, Hamblen, Hamilton, Hawkins, Jefferson)
- Mental Health Services
- Addiction Treatment
- Community Partners
- Social Services
- High-Risk Pregnancy Care
- Maternal-Fetal Medicine
- Obstetrical Care
- Prenatal Services
- Helen Ross McNabb Center
- Healthcare Partnerships
- Community Health Networks

## Healthcare Partners

- [High Risk Obstetrical Consultants](https://bettertennessee.com/partners/high-risk-obstetrical-consultants/): Partner profile: HiROC maternal-fetal medicine & high-risk pregnancy care

- [Helen Ross McNabb Foundation](https://bettertennessee.com/partners/helen-ross-mcnabb-foundation/): Partner profile: Helen Ross McNabb Center mental health & addiction services
